ITEM 1 | Dark red to purple-red smooth-skinned oval fruits, about 1.8 to 2 cm long, glossy with a slight sheen, firm and whole, not cut, heaped loosely in a cluster of about 24 pieces in a white foam bowl, with some slightly darker and some lighter red shades. | 120
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-green smooth oval fruits, about 1.8 to 2 cm long, slightly translucent with a waxy sheen, firm and whole, uncut, four pieces sitting among the red ones in the centre of the bowl. | 20
